evidence.text: The archive contains webpage compendiums, including a general FAQ and a Spring 2027 admission notice, but it does **not** provide a dated, authenticated earlier version of the admissions regulations or evidence demonstrating two formally enacted policy-rule changes. **Do not populate old policy facts or effective dates from guesswork.**

Obtain at least two authoritative policy versions (PDFs, archived official webpages, notifications or circulars), with publication dates, effective dates, version IDs and the exact sections changed. Then create per-rule records with `old_rule`, `new_rule`, `effective_date`, `superseded_at`, `source_old_url`, `source_new_url`, and `change_verified=true`. Until then, use `change_verified=false` and exclude this document from factual current-policy answers.

- General FAQ describes accepted tests and validity windows: https://www.dsu.edu.pk/faqs/
- Spring 2027 admission info advertises a special admission pathway for qualifying MDCAT or specified university entry tests at or above 50%: https://www.dsu.edu.pk/admission-info/
- Verdict: **possibly different pathways / cohorts**, not established old-versus-new replacement rules. Do NOT state that the prior test exemption policy was repealed.

- General FAQ says basic application fee **Rs. 1,000**: https://www.dsu.edu.pk/faqs/
- Spring 2027 admissions page says **Rs. 1,500 on-campus** and **Rs. 2,500 online-only undergraduate**: https://www.dsu.edu.pk/admission-info/
- Verdict: **conflicting snapshots / differing scope; change not proven**. Neither the FAQ capture date nor effective dates are available. This must NOT be answered as “the fee increased from 1,000 to 1,500.”

The source explicitly says there is no admissions or employment quota and admission and employment are merit-based, without discrimination by the listed protected attributes.

**Source:** https://www.dsu.edu.pk/equal-opportunity-policy/
**Provenance:** `equal_opportunity_policy` (source PDF; capture date unknown).
